identification: Large oil on board of a drover on a grey horse leading horses through gums, signed Wapener (or similar), gilt frame. Google Lens says the composition closely follows d'Arcy Doyle's 'The End of the Muster', so this looks like an amateur copy of a well-known Doyle print, not an original design.
